name: Ski Together ⛷️
desc:
⛷️🏂 Ski or snowboard a huge snowy resort with friends: race, jump, throw snowballs, find secret caves and dress up as an inflatable T-rex!

🆕 SNOWBOARDS ARE HERE
Switch between skis and a board anytime, and pick from 33 board designs in the Ski Shop.

🎿 IN THE GAME
❄️ 20 pistes (and a secret one), 9 chairlifts and a cozy village at Pompom Peak
❄️ Ski in a group of up to 4: share the chairlift and race your friends to the bottom
❄️ 20 challenges from the resort crew: slaloms, races, lost items, tricks
❄️ Big air, flips, spins and switch tricks: ski backwards for bonus points
❄️ Snowball fights: hit someone 3 times in a row and they turn into a snowman
❄️ Secret caves and 15 hidden treasure chests
❄️ Dress up: balaclavas, inflatable T-rex, a Yeti and 100+ skis, boards, trails and outfits
❄️ Daily challenges, a Season Pass and leaderboards

Bump into other skiers, wobble, tumble into a giant snowball and get back up laughing. See you on the slopes! ⛄
